learning_outcomes.text: Able to understand professional works, reports, and conclusions in the field of engineering, in English.
Able to write professional works, reports, and conclusions in the field of engineering, in English.
Able to communicate, in English, professional works, reports, and conclusions in the field of engineering and business.

teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts related to subjects and problem solving sessions
Presential group sessions such as discussion classes
Personal study, report writing, practical work as independent student work

assessment_methods.method: Written Test on Units 10 - 12 (Listening and Vocabulary)
Written Test on Units 10 - 12 (Reading and Grammar)
Student's classwork (participation, involvement, interest, initiative, etc.)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated based on continuous assessment components totaling 100%, comprising five written tests (10%, 10%, 10%, 15%, 25%), an oral presentation (20%), class behavior and participation (5%), and teacher's assessment (5%). Completing all continuous assessment tests is mandatory; otherwise, evaluation will be based on a 100% final exam. A minimum score of 5 on the oral test will carry over to ordinary and extraordinary resit calls. If any skill (Listening, Vocabulary, Reading, Grammar) scores below 2.5 in the written exams, the final grade cannot exceed 3. For ordinary/extraordinary calls without continuous assessment, the final grade is 75% written exam and 25% oral exam.
